caption: The drawing depicts a single round medallion or relief centrally positioned on a plain, beige background. The medallion is colored in shades of brown, gold, green, and blue, with an outer ring featuring a finely detailed pattern. Within the circular frame, there is a raised depiction of a human-like face, possibly female, adorned with a headdress consisting of radiating spikes or rays, resembling the sun. The face is surrounded by additional decorative elements suggesting a framed or ornate border. Below and within the boundary of the medallion is a curved, crescent-shaped feature. Toward the lower right of the medallion, the name “Harry Jennings” is written in small, faint letters. The overall composition is simple, with the medallion being the only object on an otherwise unmarked background.
title: Mirror Support - Victory Head
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
